name: Shekhar Social Connect
author: Shashank Shekhar

sections.description:
Shekhar Social Connect allows your visitors to start a chat conversation directly from your website with a modern floating chat button.

Easily add a fully customizable chat widget with smart business hours, auto messages, CTA text, animation effects and more — no coding required.

Perfect for businesses, agencies, WooCommerce stores and service providers who want to increase conversions and provide instant support.

Floating Chat Button

Add a beautiful Floating chat button to your website.

Customize:

• Button position (Bottom Right, Bottom Left, Middle Right, Middle Left)
• Button layout (Bubble, Rectangle, Rounded)
• Custom CTA text
• Button animations (Pulse, Bounce, Shake, Zoom)
• Notification bubble
• Custom icon upload

Smart Business Hours

Enable intelligent business hours to control when your chat is active.

Features:

• Timezone selection
• Select working days
• Auto offline message
• Smart availability indicator
• Token-based auto messages

Show visitors when you are available and provide automated responses when offline.

Auto Messages with Dynamic Tokens

Send pre-filled messages automatically.

Supported dynamic variables:

{SITE_TITLE} → Current website title
{SITE_URL} → Website URL
{CURRENT_TITLE} → Current page title
{CURRENT_URL} → Current page URL

These variables help personalize the first message.

Customization & Appearance

Match the chat widget with your brand.

• Custom button colors
• Custom header colors
• FAQ hover color
• Font family selection
• Font size control
• Custom profile avatar
• Modern premium UI

Basic Analytics (Free)

Track chat button clicks from your dashboard.

Monitor:

• Click activity
• Engagement overview

More advanced analytics coming soon.

WooCommerce Ready

Shekhar Social Connect works perfectly with WooCommerce.

Display chat button on:

• Entire website
• Specific pages
• Product pages (Premium – Coming Soon)

Help customers inquire about products instantly.

Premium Features (Coming Soon)

We are actively developing advanced features:

• White Label Mode (Remove branding)
• Multi-Agent Support
• WooCommerce Product Chat Buttons
• Trigger Options (Delay, Scroll, Exit Intent)
• Google Analytics Integration (GA4)
• Advanced Page Targeting
• Multi-Channel Support (Messenger & more)
• Webhook / CRM Integration

Stay tuned for upcoming updates.

GDPR Friendly

Shekhar Social Connect does not store personal user data.

All conversations happen directly inside external messaging apps.

Support

Need help or want to suggest a feature?

GitHub Support:
https://github.com/Shekhar0109/shekhar-social-connect/issues

Donate

If Shekhar Social Connect helps your business, consider supporting development:

Buy Me a Coffee:
https://buymeacoffee.com/shekhar0109

Thank you for supporting open-source development.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress
  2. Search for “Shekhar Social Connect”
  3. Click Install
  4. Click Activate
  5. Navigate to Shekhar Social Connect in your dashboard
  6. Enter your chat number and customize settings
sections.faq:
Can I use my own chat number?

Yes. You can use any supported messaging service number.

Can I customize the button design?

Yes. You can customize colors, position, animation, layout and text.

Can I control business hours?

Yes. Enable Smart Business Hours and define your working days and timezone.

Is this plugin mobile responsive?

Yes. Shekhar Social Connect is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. Works with WooCommerce. Advanced product integration is coming soon.
